mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies today near Verona City Hall with a temperature of 56 degrees and a waning gibbous moon phase.

We have plenty happening in town, including Yoga at Insight Wellness taking place today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.
